verdict.rationale: Langfuse's token and cost tracking docs say cost and usage capture works out of the box, with built-in prices for major providers. Its dashboards can monitor cost across models, tags or users, and custom dashboards cover cost, latency and volume. Per-request cost is visible in traces, and the Metrics API v2 returns aggregate cost and usage. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of time-period breakdowns in dashboards, explicit token-count charts (as opposed to cost) in dashboards, and independent hands-on confirmation of the cost dashboards.
